record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly reduce Adam learning rate from 1e-3 to 7e-4 and increase existing embedding dropout from 0.10 to 0.15. Stronger input regularization may reduce overfitting, while smaller updates may stabilize optimization under the additional dropout noise. Preserve features, embedding parameterization, dimensions, GRU depth, history, readout, scoring and loss. Retain seed 42, 200 batches per epoch, the 200-epoch cap and one checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Try width 96 with Adam learning rate 9e-4 across all four datasets. Lower capacity may reduce overfitting, while slightly smaller updates may stabilize training in the narrower representation. This differs from the previously evaluated configurations. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading preserve shape consistency; retain all other settings and one model per category.
